g.text: Open the Web / Flutter Windows client and sign in (JWT)
Select the session (Enrollment) and view the schedule
Create the Result (PENDING_REVIEW) and return the current question
Answer the remaining questions in order
wait until the result is ready
AiEvaluationStatus = FAILED, return the error to the student
Submit again or wait for manual grading
Show the message to the student, allow retry
Record audio (WAV 16 kHz mono) or type the answer;
Upload audio via the chunked flow (init/chunk/complete)
Let the student re-answer or use the text fallback
Render the next question for the student
Check enrollment ownership, session status IN_PROGRESS
Return 400/403 - "Session not open" / "Slot time not reached"
upload the audio to R2 / local storage
Keep the Answer, write the error into Answer.ErrorMessage
Advance the question index; return the next question or follow-up
Record AiEvaluationError and the audit log
STT - convert speech into a transcript
Generate a follow-up question if warranted
(question, sample answer, rubric, keywords, LO, content)
Run SessionGradingJob under a shared lock
